answer: reef activates an operator’s \(k\)th lifetime identity after its account burns \(k^2\) saffron. ripple attributes fresh keys to that operator and advances \(k\) atomically, never downward. A debut burns 1 saffron; ten heads burn \(1+4+\cdots+100=385\) saffron, the tenth adding 100. Parallel creation, split funding and retirement cannot reuse burned saffron or reset \(k\), so every extra clone raises the next nonrefundable bill.
